checks.recommended_action: Select Island City or Suburbs & Extended Suburbs.

checks.recommended_action: Road widths below 9m may block the scheme.

checks.label: Existing BUA entered
checks.recommended_action: Existing BUA drives the 33(7)(B) 15% incentive. Enter approved OC BUA.

checks.label: TDR permissible ≤ 0.9 (typical suburbs)
checks.recommended_action: TDR permissible varies by road width — verify vs Reg 30 Table 12 for the ward.

checks.label: Slum TDR share within 20-50% of total TDR
checks.recommended_action: Slum TDR minimum 20%, maximum 50% of admissible TDR.

checks.label: Fungible % ≤ 35 (residential)
checks.recommended_action: Fungible max 35% for residential per Reg 31(3).

checks.label: Owner share of 33(20)(B) additional = 50%
checks.recommended_action: Statutory split is 50%. Any deviation needs Municipal Commissioner approval.

checks.label: Full Scheme FSI ≤ 5.40 (4.0 + 35% fungible)
checks.recommended_action: Reduce target FSI cap or fungible to bring total ≤ 5.40.

checks.label: Net plot area (after deductions) is positive
checks.recommended_action: Setback + AOS deductions exceed gross plot. Verify inputs.

checks.label: AH share is positive (mandatory handover to MCGM)
checks.recommended_action: If base FSI already reaches cap, additional 33(20)(B) is zero — scheme reduces to plain Reg 30(A). Verify target cap.
